description.value: Beginning at 15th level, the medic's knowledge of medical injections improves further. Adrenaline Shot now grants a third additional attack with a -4 penalty on all attack rolls. Feline Vision now grants Darkvision (120 feet) and a +12 competence bonus to Perception checks. Mental Boost now grants a +6 alchemical bonus to Int/Wis/Cha. Physical Boost now grants a +6 alchemical bonus to Str/Dex/Con. Regenerative Serum now grants Fast Healing 6.
